title: Session 7: Displaying Graphics and CSS3 Animation

questions.questionText: Color depth is defined by the number of:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Bits per pixel.

questions.questionText: Another name for color depth is:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Bit depth.

questions.questionText: A higher color depth indicates:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) A higher range of colors.

questions.questionText: Image compression stores an image in:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) A reduced number of bytes.

questions.questionText: Which compression type preserves exact image details after decompression?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Lossless.

questions.questionText: Which compression generally achieves smaller file sizes?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Lossy.

questions.questionText: JPEG stands for:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Joint Photographic Experts Group.

questions.questionText: For photographs on Web pages, which format is recommended?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) JPEG.

questions.questionText: For screenshots and drawings, which format is recommended?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) PNG.

questions.questionText: PNG uses which type of compression?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Lossless.

questions.questionText: PNG does not support which color space?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) CMYK.

questions.questionText: JPEG is best suited for:
options: Continuous tone pictures such as photographs
questions.correctAnswer: Continuous tone pictures such as photographs
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Continuous tone pictures such as photographs.

questions.questionText: Which format supports animation using a series of frames?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) GIF.

questions.questionText: In a transparent image, how many colors can be hidden?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) One and only one.

questions.questionText: An interlaced GIF file:
options: Stores lines left to right only
Stores image lines in a different order
questions.correctAnswer: Stores image lines in a different order
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Stores image lines in a different order.

questions.questionText: Designers can assume a minimum display resolution of:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) 800x600.

questions.questionText: The element is:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) An empty element.

questions.questionText: The tag:
options: Creates a link between the image and the HTML page
Embeds the image data inside the HTML
questions.correctAnswer: Creates a link between the image and the HTML page
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Creates a link between the image and the HTML page.

questions.questionText: Which attribute of specifies the path of the image?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) src.

questions.questionText: Which attribute specifies alternative text for an image?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) alt.

questions.questionText: Which attributes set the dimensions of an image?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) width and height.

questions.questionText: A pixel refers to:
options: The smallest dot on the monitor screen
questions.correctAnswer: The smallest dot on the monitor screen
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) The smallest dot on the monitor screen.

questions.questionText: If an image is in a subfolder named "images", the src is:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) images/pic.jpg.

questions.questionText: Which CSS property aligns an image to the left or right with text wrapping?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) float.

questions.questionText: What is the default value of the float property?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) none.

questions.questionText: The <figure> element is:
options: A container for self-contained content such as illustrations and photos
questions.correctAnswer: A container for self-contained content such as illustrations and photos
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) A container for self-contained content such as illustrations and photos.

questions.questionText: <figcaption> is used to:
options: Add a caption to a figure
questions.correctAnswer: Add a caption to a figure
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Add a caption to a figure.

questions.questionText: An advantage of <figcaption> is that the caption:
options: Always appears along with the image even if it floats
questions.correctAnswer: Always appears along with the image even if it floats
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Always appears along with the image even if it floats.

questions.questionText: A single caption can be assigned to:
options: A group of images in one <figure>
questions.correctAnswer: A group of images in one <figure>
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) A group of images in one <figure>.

questions.questionText: The height and width properties do not include:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Padding, borders, or margins.

questions.questionText: The height value "auto" means:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) The browser calculates the height.

questions.questionText: The padding property specifies:
options: Space between the element border and its content
questions.correctAnswer: Space between the element border and its content
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Space between the element border and its content.

questions.questionText: With padding: 25px 50px 75px 100px, the left padding is:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) 100px.

questions.questionText: With padding: 25px 50px 75px 100px, the top padding is:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) 25px.

questions.questionText: In the padding shorthand, values are applied in the order:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Top, right, bottom, left.

questions.questionText: A thumbnail is:
options: A small image or part of a larger image
questions.correctAnswer: A small image or part of a larger image
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) A small image or part of a larger image.

questions.questionText: Thumbnails are used to:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Improve page load speed.

questions.questionText: Clicking a thumbnail typically:
options: Links to the larger original image
questions.correctAnswer: Links to the larger original image
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Links to the larger original image.

questions.questionText: CSS transitions were first introduced by:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Apple.

questions.questionText: Which two specifications are required for a CSS3 transition?
options: The CSS property to add an effect to and the duration
questions.correctAnswer: The CSS property to add an effect to and the duration
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) The CSS property to add an effect to and the duration.

questions.questionText: The transition-duration property defines:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) The duration of the transition.

questions.questionText: The transition-delay property defines:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) When the transition starts.

questions.questionText: The transition-timing-function describes:
options: How the speed changes during a transition
questions.correctAnswer: How the speed changes during a transition
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) How the speed changes during a transition.

questions.questionText: The shorthand transition property sets:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Up to four transition properties.

questions.questionText: CSS3 animations animate transitions from:
options: One CSS style configuration to another
questions.correctAnswer: One CSS style configuration to another
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) One CSS style configuration to another.

questions.questionText: The @keyframes rule is used to:
options: Define the appearance of the animation
questions.correctAnswer: Define the appearance of the animation
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Define the appearance of the animation.

questions.questionText: Which property sets the duration of an animation cycle?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) animation-duration.

questions.questionText: The default value of animation-play-state is:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) running.

questions.questionText: animation-iteration-count specifies:
options: The number of times an animation runs
questions.correctAnswer: The number of times an animation runs
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) The number of times an animation runs.

questions.questionText: animation-direction: alternate makes the animation:
options: Play in reverse on alternate cycles
questions.correctAnswer: Play in reverse on alternate cycles
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Play in reverse on alternate cycles.

questions.questionText: Which is an advantage of CSS3 animations over script-based animations?
options: Easy to use without JavaScript knowledge
questions.correctAnswer: Easy to use without JavaScript knowledge
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Easy to use without JavaScript knowledge.

questions.questionText: CSS3 media queries allow users to specify:
options: A conditional expression for media type
questions.correctAnswer: A conditional expression for media type
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) A conditional expression for media type.

questions.questionText: A media query for mobile devices with max screen width 480px is written as:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) media="screen and (max-width: 480px)".
